title: Privacy Policy | PetroBind Global
text:
LEGAL

PRIVACY POLICY

What we collect when you send an RFQ, why we use it, and your rights under Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act 2010. We do not sell personal data.

Contact PetroBind
Terms of Use

Last updated: 3 September 2026

1. Who is responsible for your data

Evevo Technologies Sdn. Bhd. (Company No. 202301008750 (1502671-K)), trading as PetroBind Global ("PetroBind", "we"), controls the personal data collected through this website. This notice explains what we collect and how we use it, consistent with Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA).

Contact for privacy matters: sales@petrobindglobal.com.

2. What we collect

When you submit a Request for Quotation (RFQ) or contact us, we collect the information you provide, which typically includes:

Company name and country
Contact person name, business email, and phone number
Your requirement details — product grade, quantity, destination port, Incoterm, packing preference, delivery window, and any notes or documents you attach
3. Why we use it

We use this information only to:

Respond to your enquiry and prepare a quotation
Carry on commercial correspondence about a potential or actual order
Meet record-keeping, tax, and trade-documentation obligations connected to a transaction
4. Legal basis

We process your data on the basis of the consent you give when submitting the RFQ form, and, once an order proceeds, for the performance of the contract and to comply with legal obligations. You may withdraw consent for pre-contract correspondence at any time by emailing us; this will end our ability to progress your enquiry.

5. Who we share it with

We do not sell personal data. We disclose it only where necessary to handle your enquiry or order:

Our email service provider (Resend), which delivers the RFQ to our sales inbox
Supply, packing, freight, and inspection partners, where needed to price or fulfil a specific order
Banks and authorities, where required for payment, customs, or export documentation
Professional advisers or regulators where we are legally required to disclose
6. International transfer

Because trade is cross-border, your data may be processed outside Malaysia by the parties described above. We take reasonable steps to ensure it is handled with a comparable level of protection.

7. Retention

We keep RFQ and correspondence records for as long as needed to handle the enquiry and, where a transaction proceeds, for the period required by applicable tax and trade law. We remove or anonymise data we no longer need.

8. Security

We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect the data we hold. No transmission over the internet is completely secure; you send information to us at your own risk, and we ask that you not send bank details or other sensitive data through the website form.

9. Your rights

Under the PDPA you may request access to the personal data we hold about you, ask us to correct it if it is inaccurate, and limit how we process it. To make a request, email sales@petrobindglobal.com. We may need to verify your identity before responding.

10. Cookies

This website does not set advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. Your browser may store limited functional information (such as a remembered scroll position) locally on your device; this is not transmitted to us.

11. Changes

We may update this notice. The version published on this page is the one that applies.

Privacy questions or requests: email sales@petrobindglobal.com. See also the Terms of Use.
